objective: Al terminar comparas personas, lugares y cosas con comparativos, superlativos, as … as, too y enough.

input.recap_es: Repasa: adjetivos y opuestos, comparativos (-er / more … than), superlativos (the -est / the most), as … as, too y enough.

md_es: - *taller than · bigger than · more expensive than · better · worse*
- *the tallest · the biggest · the most interesting · the best · the worst*
- *as good as · not as expensive as · too noisy · big enough · enough money*
- *I prefer A to B. · I think … is the best choice.*
